cards.rule: HER FLIP: no entry unless a 2, 3, 4 or 5 minute candle has flipped her way, a real turn (green to red or red to green), at least 10c gold / $5 BTC past its open. Never a 1 minute candle, never a closed-candle wait.
HER THIRDS: no long in the top share of the channel, no short in the bottom share. Clear anywhere else. BTC 33% up to $500 channels, 20% over. Gold 33% under $10, 20% on $10 to $25, 15% over $25.
HER CHANNEL is session band to session band (the σ lines and session VWAP). Never a zone, the pink or any other band.
DOJI: a green doji then a red candle is a short only; a red doji then a green candle is a long only.
THE ZONES: no trade inside the red zone or the green zone, long or short. $1.50 either side of a zone and of the Bollinger: not allowed to enter within it.
GOLD PINK 55%: from pink to green, no short in the bottom 55%; from pink to red, no long in the top 55%. Main, rejection and the copy.
BLUE VWAP WALLS when the bands are small.
BTC PINK RE-AIM: an unfilled long refused by the pink re-aims to the short.

THE PINK SLOPE: it's sliding when three candles or more have hit the pink and rejected on a down slope. A down slope (each rejection closing lower) holds longs only; an up slope (each closing higher) holds shorts only. The hold ends when price breaks through the pink by 25c gold / $8 BTC, read on the live tick.
STALE CALL GUARD: a call over 90 seconds old never fires when a seat opens.
HER REACH WALL: no trade into an unbroken session band or the pink within $1 gold / $50 BTC, or into a red/green zone within $1 gold. A poke under the break distance is not a break.
cards.note: the 33/20 stands. this is a hard tolerance for when bands are small. btc’s is $25 at band widths under $100 during tight bands, golds is a hard $1 within that

cards.rule: PINK TOLERANCE: the pink is a wall only inside 15% gold / 20% BTC of the band-to-band distance, either side. Beyond that it is no obstacle: no cushion, no floor, no slide or climb hold.
NEVER INTO AN UNBROKEN PINK: no long under the pink until it breaks up 25c gold / $8 BTC; no short over it until it breaks down by the same. Inside her tolerance only.
ON HER SIDE OF THE BREAK: band breaks are traded in the direction of the break, with price on that side. A wick through is not an entry.
EVERY ORDER PASSES HER WALLS AT THE WIRE OR DOES NOT GO. Fails closed.
HER $10 LEVEL: no trading into an even $10 level when the target is within $1.50, only away from it.
BROKE IT THIS CANDLE = HER SIDE NOW: no trade back against a band or pink broken this candle until price breaks back by her distance.
NO THIRDS FLIP: a refused call is never turned into the other side.
INDEPENDENT CALLS: only an executed trade closes the window; a fresh call on the same side can replace an unfilled one. Main and rejection: one executed trade per window.
HER ENTRY: at a band rejection, a 2 to 5 minute candle flips away from the band (red to green long, green to red short). At a Bollinger, session band, red/green zone or pink.
The rejection model takes the zone rejection her twin sees when her own read is empty.
cards.note: she now has the ability to make her own calls aside from main. she’s independent under the same framework.
